messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: idea: "this week/month in Stan"
parts:
Hi,

I've noticed a new genre in blog posts about software, e.g.,

- This Week in Rust (Mozilla's new systems programming language) (http://cmr.github.io/blog/2014/02/09/this-week-in-rust/)
- This Week in Cyanogenmod (http://www.cyanogenmod.org/blog/this-week-in-cm-mar-21-2014)

This Week in Rust is basically just a summary of the commits that week.

I think a main attraction of the form is that it's on a blog and one can point
a feed reader at it. I imagine some people might prefer that to following
activity on the mailing list.

Best wishes,

-a

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] idea: "this week/month in Stan"
parts:
I support it. We can put it on Andrew's blog and have it go up every week we don't have a MOW, unless we think it'll be better going on a Stan blog somewhere. I'm all about having users know we exist and that we're still contributing to Stan.

I don't know about reading through the commit log, but I can jot things down at the meetings and post it up, unless someone else wants to handle it.



Slightly unrelated -- anyone mind if I start a Stan meetup group in NYC?


Daniel
